name: Sentrook
description: Scans agent tool calls with Sentrook and allows, asks for approval, or blocks them.

configSchema.description: Sentrook reads and checks these settings itself and reports any it cannot read (gateway log, openclaw sentrook verify, /sentrook status, an owner notice), so a typo never makes OpenClaw disable the plugin. Nothing here is enforced by this schema.

scanUrl.description: Sentrook scan service base URL. Non-default values must be https on a firstdataunion.org host unless SENTROOK_DEV_ENDPOINTS=1.

rookeryUrl.description: Rookery base URL (same host rule as scanUrl).

oidcIssuer.description: Identity service issuer URL (same host rule as scanUrl).

clientId.description: Scan client id. Recommended: an env SecretRef to SENTROOK_SCAN_CLIENT_ID, with the value in the state-dir .env. Without it the plugin reads SENTROOK_SCAN_CLIENT_ID from the environment, then from the state-dir .env.

clientSecret.description: Scan client secret: an env SecretRef to SENTROOK_SCAN_CLIENT_SECRET, with the value in the state-dir .env, never the value itself. Without it the plugin reads SENTROOK_SCAN_CLIENT_SECRET from the environment, then from the state-dir .env.

oidcAudience.description: Token audience (default sentrook). Text, or an env SecretRef.

oidcScope.description: Token scope (default sentrook.scan). Text, or an env SecretRef.

mode.description: enforce (default) or observe. observe scores and logs every call but never blocks or asks.

reviewAt.description: Ask the user at or above this risk: a number from 0 to 100 (default 45).

blockAt.description: Block at or above this risk: a number from 0 to 101 (default 80); never below reviewAt.

onScanError.description: What happens to a call when the scan fails: allow, deny or review (default review).

timeoutMs.description: Scan timeout in milliseconds, at least 1000 (default 30000).

approval.description: { interactiveTimeoutMs: how long an approval waits, above 0 (default 300000); scheduledIntentKinds: a list of user, cron, subagent, system }.

stateDir.description: Where the plugin keeps its files (default ~/.openclaw/sentrook).

trafficLog.description: { enabled: true or false (default true); path; maxBytes: at least 1024 }.

historyLimit.description: How many earlier steps a scan sends: 1 to 200 (default 20).

inputCapBytes.description: Largest tool input sent in full, at least 1024 bytes.

historyArgsCapBytes.description: Largest earlier-step arguments sent in full, at least 256 bytes.

hideToolCalls.description: true or false (default false): hide the calls, with redacted arguments, that /sentrook-why, background-save notices and the dashboard show.

dashboardShowCalls.description: Replaced by hideToolCalls; still accepted, does nothing.

packs.description: Scan packs sent with each scan: a list of names (default tier1).

trustedSenders.description: Sender ids whose messages are sent as from a trusted sender (not the owner): a list.

trustedRoles.description: Chat role ids whose members' messages are sent as from a trusted sender: a list.

grants.description: Standing grants: a list of { kind, pattern, allows?, scope?, granted_at? }; kind is destination, file, provider, repo or credential. scope is persistent when absent; a config grant has no session, so scope session is never sent (/sentrook-grant adds session grants without editing config).

channelBindings.description: Channels this deployment normally delivers to; sent as destination grants. /sentrook-bind adds more without editing config.

skillReview.description: allow (default): OpenClaw's own background saves (the Skill Workshop review, the memory flush, the skill collection review) are sent as the host's, not the owner's, and their saves as self-edits judged against the conversation they came from. review: sent like any other call, as before. Any other value reads as allow. Either way their saves are never asked about: nobody can answer a prompt in those runs.
